ns2:course.label: Found of the US Air Force II
ns2:course.description: "The Foundations of the United States Air Force" is a survey course designed to introduce students to the United States Air Force and provides an overview of the basic characteristics, missions, and organization of the Air Force. Requires concurrent enrollment with AFAS 102. Prerequisite: AFAS 111 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Requires concurrent enrollment with AFAS 102. Prerequisite: AFAS 111 or consent of instructor.
